notes.title: V29 - Housekeeping update
notes.content:
V29 - Housekeeping update


 Reduced flickering on menu items
 Flickering highlights and effects and certain expanding/contracting objects now properly do so in sync with a global variable so they feel smoother 
 Resolved the broken Steam Leaderboards button
 Resolved crash on exit on Mac
 Now fully working on Linux (sorry about that)
 Full Steamdeck support confirmed
 Proper Cloud saving Cross-Platform Win/Mac/Lin
 Updated store page and features where appropriate
 Changed share button to now copy message/score to clipboard so you can use it anywhere instead of opening up a direct link to Twitter
 Decreased install size
 Updated the Unity backend
 Migrating save files (copying not deleting so old one is still there if something goes wrong) from old versions to new save location to be consistent with all my games.
 Removed additional exit menu and videos. 
 Added unified Update text and "More Games By" panel on main menu that will be in all my games going forward. If you click the panel it will open to the games page and then won't suggest that game again on this installation. Also allows me to push update text without a full game update in case of urgent issues. 
 Probably other minor fixes I forgot (sorry)


Hotfix 2025-03-16 V29 - Added proper Simplified Chinese Font for Linux systems

Thanks yall, let me know if I missed anything or you hit problems :)
adamvision <3

notes.title: Ding Dong XL Version 7 Update
notes.content:
A new challenge awaits you in the brand new game changing Infinite Mode! Improved graphics, better balance, and many more additions and changes. Check out Ding Dong XL V7 now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32763348/a4d869a960a2e0915114ecc60bc25c23a3a4f052.gif

Patch Notes: (additional leader boards + online for switch)
 New Infinite play mode added
 New Unlock-able Space Rocks skin
 Bonus Points power-up is now worth 5 Points
 Added Bit Blaster, Orbt, and Diamo songs for each of the special characters
 When you're stationary with a time slow power-up, the growth of the ball will stop completely
 Early button presses after death will not be erroneously detected
 Power-up timers correctly reset when dying and restarting they now also disappear upon death 
 Pink enemy now correctly has it's trail fade in/out with the rest of the enemy
 Modified and added some little secrets here and there
 Re-balanced some late game elements to ensure there are always viable paths to take and made 250+ not dependent on power-ups
 Player can now remain idle slightly longer before exploding

I hope you enjoy the latest update, and if you do, make sure to leave a Steam review and share the game with your friends. Thanks for the continued support of my games. 

-Adam Nickerson (@nickervision)


Don't forget to also add Super Bit Blaster XL to your Steam Wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/865040/Super_Bit_Blaster_XL/

notes.title: V3a
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28434536/3059a3fd58476de522254c6456403f0ad7b8b3b4.gif
Diamo XL -  V3

 Added support for Russian, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese and Simplified Chinese languages. (not perfect, but getting better thanks to our community)
 Resolved really bad gamepad joystick problems. Was I having a bad day? How did I not notice this in testing? What the heck happened? My apologies, hopefully this works way better now. Thanks especially to Wreckwren for pointing it out more specifically.
 Resolved some weird GFX glitches from trails on enemies.
 Improved several explosions and added new indicator for when enemies are about to enter the screen. Slightly different for each enemy.
 Modified some Dpad and joystick sensitivity to try and help those with bad joysticks getting the always down problem.
 Converted the entire button system in the game to no longer use textures, now using Rich Text.
 Resolved some issues with the Video Resolution menu where the player would have to sometimes hit the left or right a number of times to get the next value.
 Resolved some graphical glitches related to Ultra-wide monitors.
 Mac Version should now always properly open in the Full screen with no Menu Bar below by default.
 Resolved some issues with Vibrations, and the Vibrate button correctly working.
 Modified the Thanks system to display all my games on Steam as well as be more streamlined and take up less space. (thanks)
 Screen shake issues have been resolved on screens that aren't 60 HZ
 Resolved some achievements not being activated correctly.
 Resolved a few problems related to screen refresh rate and delta time incorrectly displaying objects as a result.
 Resolved an issue with the leaderboards.
 Upgraded engine to Latest Unity Version


V3a:
-Updated some Spanish / Chinese translations
-Updated to newest Unity Engine Version to hopefully resolve some game closing incorrectly errors
-Developer page is now correctly linked in the thanks page
-Modified text in thanks page
-Resolved issue where player could jump the track and get bugged out or auto move.
-Set all enemy indicators to be slightly longer giving more notice where they're originating from.
-Resolved Resolution change issue
-Updated DD video to more accurately reflect its state

Thank you to everyone for playing and sharing the game with your friends and family I appreciate your support immensely. If you are enjoying Diamo, make sure to leave a brief Steam Review and let others know to check it out, this is massively important for us small developers.

notes.title: V3 BETA
notes.content:
BETA -  V3

To try out the BETA version;
--> Right click the game in the library tab
--> Click Properties
--> Click the BETAS tab
--> From the Drop down box select "betav3"
--> Click close

The beta should then automatically download. Make sure that if the BETA doesn't work for you, you use the same method to turn it off.

The BETA version includes a variety of fixes for reported bugs including things to do with Input, vibration, and GFX issues. I have also added a translation system (not perfect) that contains 8 Languages. As well as resolved a massive controller/gamepad issue that was occurring for some people (thanks reviews for pointing it out). I'll leave this in BETA for a day while I make sure there is no issues, so please feel free to tell me below.

notes.title: V2 Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11525962/3059a3fd58476de522254c6456403f0ad7b8b3b4.gif
Diamo XL -  V2

 Close calls will now be correctly counted alongside combos
 On screen point bursts for close calls, point grabs, and diamond fills will now correctly reflect their after-multiplier values
 Fixed bug that allowed play to choose characters before unlocking them
 Fixed bug where music and some SFX weren’t playing after a couple plays
 Fixed key input so only pushing in the same direction you are going will increase your speed.
 Added an option to the video menu to turn off background effects for improved frame rate on some machines
 Fixed issue where a player had just completed a diamond and then crossed a new line it wouldn’t be recorded if the diamond clear effect had not completed
 The gamepad will now correctly take first control over mouse input
 New, less subtle player unlock animation
 Tweaked explosions to be more satisfying
 Increased visibility of indicators for enemies that appear from the top and bottom, giving more time before appearance as well as brighter color

Thank you to everyone for playing and sharing the game with your friends and family I appreciate your support immensely. If you are enjoying Diamo XL, make sure to leave a brief Steam Review and let others know to check it out. The reviews are extremely important for helping new players find my games.

Adam Nickerson
Nickervision Studios
